script_text:
Voice Young adult male character, around 24–26 years old. Warm, bright and friendly voice, medium pitch, slightly playful and charming, energetic but never childish or exaggerated. Clear French pronunciation, natural conversational delivery, subtle North African warmth without a strong regional accent. He sounds like an enthusiastic young hostel  professional who loves cooking, learning and welcoming people. Expressive smile in the voice, confident, curious and optimistic. Premium yet approachable. Cartoon character personality, but realistic human voice. Dynamic pacing with natural pauses and expressive emphasis. Suitable for a hospitality school mascot and social media videos.
